en.title: Return Any Longest Palindromic Contiguous Substring
en.description:
Return a palindromic contiguous substring of maximum length from the original string. If there are several longest answers, return any one of them; the lexicographically smallest or the earliest one must not be additionally required. A single character is also a palindrome.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: One line containing a string s of ASCII English letters or digits. The original bound 1≤|s|≤1000 is kept, and the string is case-sensitive.
en.output: Output any one longest palindromic substring, optionally followed by one terminating newline; do not output quotes or explanatory text.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: aba; bb; 7. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Enumerate odd and even centers and expand outward. For each center, keep the longest substring it can reach, and output the longest one at the end. The reference program's internal tie-breaking is not part of the output requirement; the semantic checker accepts every optimal result.
